primary_inference.family: Three ML challengers versus production OLS, separately for RB and HO

method.qualification: Reconstructed historical forecasts, not live performance or an untouched holdout. Assumes prior-session rack postings were available by the next decision. Roll exclusions inherit the production calendar-based filter. Correction targets and calibration errors come only from earlier out-of-sample forecasts. All-row probability target is rack_change > 0; zero changes are incorrect directional alerts. Production control retains its original in-sample-residual probability/threshold method; the OLS adapter control uses the same OOS calibration and action rule as ML. All intervals use earlier OOS errors and are empirical, not guaranteed conditional coverage. Full-period primary MAE intervals use a six-test Bonferroni correction and block-length sensitivity; these bootstrap intervals are approximate under dependence. Secondary and subperiod intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Huber estimates a robust location, not a guaranteed conditional mean. Gross timing proxies assume equal volume, exclude inventory/fees, and are not actual savings. No automatic promotion.
